run_create_video_mnist: run the script to generate an MNIST optimal transport interpolation video from a trained model pickle
run_interp_function: run the interp function to compute optimal transport histograms between two MNIST digit distributions
run_main_with_args: run main with exp_root and optional pkl_tag num_row num_col num_interp num_estimation_iter arguments
review_interp_function: review the interp function that uses Sinkhorn or learned transport to interpolate between MNIST digit pairs
review_main_function: review the main function that assembles interpolation frames into a grid and renders an MP4 video
